description: Use when an agent must compare lending yields on Base. Input: optional protocol (aave-v3,compound-v3,morpho,moonwell) and asset (USDC,WETH,cbBTC,wstETH,cbETH,EURC). Output: JSON per market supply/borrow APY, utilization, supplied/borrowed amount and TVL in USD, sorted by supply APY, with block. Computed from contract state; base rates, rewards excluded; not advice. Example: ?asset=USDC Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

asset.description: Comma list of USDC, WETH (or ETH), cbBTC, wstETH, cbETH, EURC (default all). Bad value → 400 before payment (not charged)

protocol.description: Comma list of aave-v3, compound-v3, morpho, moonwell (default all). Bad value → 400 before payment (not charged)

name: defi_yields
title: DeFi lending yields and market TVL on Base: Aave v3, Compound v3, Morpho, Moonwell
